assumptions.dailyModel: Rain before overflow before demand; no sub-daily precision.
assumptions.shortageDefinition: Any positive daily unmet volume; streaks reset at each annual boundary. Not meteorological drought.
assumptions.decisionRule: Smallest positive standard candidate satisfying target fraction of each annual standard maximum, with 1e-10 times that annual maximum in liters as tolerance.
assumptions.displacement: Modeled freshwater displacement equals modeled rainwater supplied only if it substitutes existing freshwater demand; not measured savings.
assumptions.limitation: Historical sensitivity comparison over 2023–2025 only. Not a climate normal, forecast, trend, calibrated risk measure, engineering guarantee, or financial optimum.
